# pve_sdn_zone_vxlan (Resource)

Manages a VXLAN SDN zone (`/cluster/sdn/zones`, type `vxlan`) building an overlay between the peers' VTEPs. Creating, updating, or deleting a zone only changes the pending SDN configuration; run the `pve_sdn_apply` action to apply it to the running configuration. Changing `zone` forces recreation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a VXLAN SDN zone between the nodes' VTEPs.
resource "pve_sdn_zone_vxlan" "zone1" {
  zone  = "zone1"
  peers = "10.0.0.1,10.0.0.2"

  mtu        = 1450
  vxlan_port = 4789
  nodes      = "pve1,pve2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier (2 to 8 characters, starting with a letter). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `dhcp` (String) Name of the DHCP server backend for this zone (PVE `dhcp`). Must be one of: `dnsmasq`.
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS API server (PVE `dns`) for this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) DNS domain zone for this zone (PVE `dnszone`), for example `mydomain.com`.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric (PVE `pve-sdn-fabric-id`) to use as the underlay for this VXLAN zone, for example a `pve_sdn_fabric_openfabric` fabric.
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM (PVE `ipam`) managing IP addresses in this zone, for example `pve`.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone (PVE `mtu`), used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names where this zone should be created (PVE `pve-node-list`), for example `pve1,pve2`.
- `peers` (String) Comma-separated list of peer addresses (PVE `ip-list`) that are part of the VXLAN zone, usually the IPs of the participating nodes, for example `10.0.0.1,10.0.0.2`.
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server (PVE `reversedns`) for this zone.
- `vxlan_port` (Number) UDP port used for the VXLAN tunnel (PVE `vxlan-port`, default `4789`). Must be between 1 and 65536.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) The read-only SDN configuration revision (PVE `digest`) of the zone section.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import a PVE SDN zone by its zone identifier.
terraform import pve_sdn_zone_vxlan.zone1 "zone1"
```
